When was it measured or observed?Mar-2025–Jun-2026 monthly

Reported POS terminals, monthly

Report an error

01What does this evidence establish?

POS terminals reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) rose from 561 in March 2025 to 1,651 in June 2026, within CBY-Aden's reporting scope. Between December 2025 (1,357) and January 2026 (1,473), the raw totals imply growth of 8.55%, while the January source graphic displays +11%. The May 2026 source graphic displays +2.4%, which the published totals for April 2026 (1,583) and May 2026 (1,636) do not yield; because the source contradicts itself, this resource computes no change for April to May 2026. The chart plots the reported totals, the publisher's displayed percentages are given in the chart note, and each mismatch is recorded as a discrepancy within the source. Terminal counts are devices, not merchants, unique users or an inclusion outcome.

Another view of the evidence

02What does it measure?

The monthly number of point-of-sale (POS) terminals reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) within its reporting scope, March 2025 to June 2026.

03Who or what does it apply to?

POS terminals within the payment-system reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden); how far that scope covers each area of Yemen is not established.

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to June 2026; the series runs monthly from March 2025. June 2026 was the latest monthly POS release on the Arabic payments page of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) when checked on 3 October 2026; the English payments page still listed January 2026 as the latest. The figures should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable release is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

Growth in terminal numbers does not show merchant adoption, active use of POS services, growth in unique users or an inclusion outcome. The +11% displayed in the January 2026 release and the 8.55% change derived from the raw totals are not arithmetically consistent. Nor do the published April and May 2026 totals yield the +2.4% displayed in the May 2026 release; no change is computed for that month. The totals fall within the reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and are not shown to cover all of Yemen.

Limits of the measure

Every monthly release from March 2025 is a one-page infographic, and its design changed in January 2026 and again in February 2026; continuity of the reporting scope across these changes has not been verified.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Monthly terminal totals as published in the monthly POS releases of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden). The December 2025 to January 2026 change of 8.55% is derived by this resource (1,473 divided by 1,357, minus one) and is kept beside the +11% displayed in the January release; neither figure replaces the other. The May 2026 release displays +2.4%, which the published April (1,583) and May (1,636) totals do not yield; because the release contradicts itself, no April to May change is derived, and the two totals and the displayed percentage are shown as published. A smaller mismatch in June 2025 is also kept: 733 to 791 terminals implies 7.91%, while the June release displays +7.6%.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
